#### Description
- Implements `EmaCrossUniverseSelectionModel`:
  Adds `EmaCrossUniverseSelectionModel` and `EmaCrossUniverseSelectionFrameworkAlgorithm` to show the new model in action.

#### Related Issue
Closes #1944 

#### Motivation and Context
Add examples of framework models

#### Requires Documentation Change
Yes, specially because the implementation of the python version of `FundamentalUniverseSelectionModel` that serves two purposes: example of universe selection model and base class for other universe selection models, since the pythonnet doesn't deal well with inheritance of abstract classes.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Manually with the `EmaCrossUniverseSelectionFrameworkAlgorithm`.

issue_context.title: Implement an Indicator Universe Selection Model
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Provide a framework version of [EmaCrossUniverseSelectionAlgorithm](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Algorithm.CSharp/EmaCrossUniverseSelectionAlgorithm.cs) that shows how to use indicators to select an universe. 

#### Actual Behavior
No equivalent of [EmaCrossUniverseSelectionAlgorithm](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Algorithm.CSharp/EmaCrossUniverseSelectionAlgorithm.cs).

#### Potential Solution
Implements `EmaCrossUniverseSelectionModel` and `EmaCrossUniverseSelectionFrameworkAlgorithm`.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)

review_comments: Do we want to add these ctor overloads to support python? Looks like the code that calls this is all custom code, is it possible for that code to perform the convert operation or does it have to happen in a c# context?
I think that we do. If we want to create one of these universes (I added for `FineFundamentalFilteredUniverse` in #1979) directly from a python algorithm, the overload is there.
